mapper.sql: select i.image_id, i.combination_id, i.object_key, i.original_name, i.content_type, i.file_size, i.user_id, i.image_state, i.expire_time, i.delete_attempts, i.next_retry_time, i.last_error, i.create_by, i.create_time, i.update_by, i.update_time from fx67ll_dortmund_return_image i
mapper.insert: insert into fx67ll_dortmund_return_image (combination_id, object_key, original_name, content_type, file_size, user_id, image_state, expire_time, delete_attempts, next_retry_time, last_error, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{combinationId}, #{objectKey}, #{originalName}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{userId}, #{imageState}, #{expireTime}, #{deleteAttempts}, #{nextRetryTime}, #{lastError}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select count(1) from fx67ll_dortmund_return_image where combination_id = #{combinationId} and image_state = 'B'
mapper.update: update fx67ll_dortmund_return_image set combination_id = #{combinationId}, image_state = 'B', expire_time = null, next_retry_time = null, last_error = null, update_time = now() where image_id = #{imageId} and user_id = #{userId} and image_state = 'T' and combination_id is null
mapper.select: select i.image_id from fx67ll_dortmund_return_image i left join fx67ll_dortmund_return_combination c on c.combination_id = i.combination_id where ( (i.image_state = 'T' and i.expire_time is not null and i.expire_time <= now()) or (i.image_state = 'B' and (c.combination_id is null or c.adopted_flag <> 'Y')) or (i.image_state in ('D', 'Q') and (i.next_retry_time is null or i.next_retry_time <= now()) and i.delete_attempts < #{quarantineRetryLimit}) ) order by coalesce(i.next_retry_time, i.expire_time, i.create_time), i.image_id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update fx67ll_dortmund_return_image set image_state = 'D', expire_time = null, next_retry_time = now(), last_error = #{reason}, update_time = now() where image_id = #{imageId} and image_state in ('T', 'B', 'D', 'Q')

update fx67ll_dortmund_return_image set delete_attempts = delete_attempts + 1, last_error = #{error}, image_state = 'Q''D', next_retry_time = date_add(now(), interval 15 minute), update_time = now() where image_id = #{imageId} and image_state in ('T', 'B', 'D', 'Q')
